contract.intent: Run the same benchmark corpus under the harness with independent samples and preserve human approval gates.

outcomes.statement: The same corpus has three independent harness-bound runs per task, each at or before human approval.
The harness collection preserves bound run evidence without auto-approving or discarding pending samples.
The paired report exposes the fresh baseline artifact rates and keeps duration unavailable until every harness sample is complete.

docs.reason: No documentation behavior is changed in this data-collection phase.

checks.command: node --check scripts/run-agentskit-os-harness-benchmark.mjs && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const root='.codex/verification/phase-39/harness/runs'; const tasks=['bug-off-by-one','test-coverage-gap','feat-formatter']; const states=[]; for(const task of tasks){const d=root+'/'+task; const samples=fs.existsSync(d)?fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).filter(e=>e.isDirectory()):[]; if(samples.length!==3) process.exit(1); for(const sample of samples){const runs=fs.readdirSync(d+'/'+sample.name+'/runs',{withFileTypes:true}).filter(e=>e.isDirectory()); if(runs.length!==1) process.exit(1); const x=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(d+'/'+sample.name+'/runs/'+runs[0].name+'/run.json')); states.push(x.state); if(!['AWAITING_HUMAN_APPROVAL','COMPLETE'].includes(x.state)) process.exit(1)}} console.log(JSON.stringify({status:'passed',criteria:['harness-corpus'],taskCount:tasks.length,samples:states.length,states}))"

node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const root='.codex/verification/phase-39/harness/runs'; const files=[]; const walk=(d)=>{for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=d+'/'+e.name; if(e.isDirectory()) walk(p); else if(e.name==='run.json') files.push(p)}}; walk(root); const ok=files.length===9 && files.every(p=>{const x=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p)); return x.benchmark?.suiteId==='agentskit-os-coding-phase-28' && x.benchmark?.mode==='harness' && ['AWAITING_HUMAN_APPROVAL','COMPLETE'].includes(x.state)}); if(!ok) process.exit(1); console.log(JSON.stringify({status:'passed',criteria:['harness-evidence'],runCount:files.length}))"

pnpm --filter @agentskit/harness build && node -e "const {spawnSync}=require('child_process'); const r=spawnSync(process.execPath,['scripts/run-agentskit-os-harness-benchmark.mjs','--collect','--repeats','3','--phase-root','.codex/verification/phase-39/harness'],{encoding:'utf8'}); const x=JSON.parse(r.stdout.trim().split(/\r?\n/).at(-1)); const ok=x.report.qualityGate.status==='insufficient-data' && x.report.comparisons.every(c=>c.improvement.duration==='unavailable' && c.baselineArtifactAcceptanceRate!==null); if(!ok) process.exit(1); console.log(JSON.stringify({status:'passed',criteria:['comparison-integrity'],qualityGate:x.report.qualityGate.status,artifactAcceptanceRates:x.report.comparisons.map(c=>c.baselineArtifactAcceptanceRate)}))"
